findings.title: No tests added for localization fallback behavior
findings.body: The PR introduces a custom fallback mechanism (FallbackLocaleList) and changes pluralization loading, but no tests are included. Without tests, regressions in translation fallback order, fallback loading via ensure_loaded!, or pluralization integration could go unnoticed. Given that this feature affects every I18n lookup, test coverage should verify that translations fall back through the expected locale chain and that pluralization still works.
